* **GP** — Paid release: Pro/Premium are NOT live (flags off, store products unconfirmed, no real sandbox purchase ever run: docs/PAID_BRANCH_STATUS.md). Do not publish a paid-topic video before the paid build is live in the stores and the owner confirms the plan names and the 7-day trial.

* *Topic note* — Groups need a server and an account; the video must say so (inventory §3). Do not publish before the paid build and the server are live (gate GP).

## 2. YouTube description (the first two lines are the hook shown before “more”)

### 2.1 English (main) — 2068 characters (limit 5000)

```text
Write your own questions, give the test to a group, see who answered what.
A look at Teacher Pro in LabGuide.

In this video:
• Building a test from your own questions (several options, one correct answer, optional explanation) or from copies of questions in the app.
• Assigning it to a whole group or to one student, with a deadline and a number of attempts.
• Results by student and by question, the questions most often missed, and a CSV export.

What LabGuide does today:
• Teacher Pro is a Pro feature of the Teacher Pro plan (and Premium). Today’s free groups and assignments from the app’s own questions stay free.
• It needs an account and an internet connection: tests, assignments and results are stored on LabGuide’s server.
• A teacher sees only the students who joined the group themselves, by a code or an invitation; e-mail addresses are not shown.

Pro features: part of LabGuide’s optional paid plans (Student Pro, Teacher Pro, Specialist Pro, Premium), with a 7-day free trial where offered. Features that are free today stay free. Prices are shown in the App Store / Google Play.

Good to know:
• Results export is CSV only; there is no PDF export for teacher results.

LabGuide is a clinical-laboratory companion app for lab professionals and students (English, Russian, Uzbek). It is a learning and reference tool: it does not diagnose or interpret patient results.
Get the app: [[LINK_APP_STORE]] · [[LINK_PLAY]]

Illustrative data — not patient results.
Educational use, not medical advice.
English synthetic narration (Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0); English subtitles.
Expert review pending: this content has not yet been reviewed by a laboratory specialist.

Credits
• Narration: AI text-to-speech, Kokoro-82M v1.0 (Apache-2.0), voice af_heart, run with kokoro-onnx (MIT).
• Fonts: Inter and Instrument Serif, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
• Illustrations, schematics, animation and app screens: LabGuide (own work). No third-party photographs, stock footage, music or logos.
• Made with Remotion and FFmpeg.

#LabGuide #TeacherTools #MedicalEducation
```

## 10. End screen / CTA suggestion

* YouTube end screen (last ~7–20 s): subscribe + the next video in the SAME language edition (`premium_overview`, `exam_simulation`) + the playlist `[[LINK_PLAYLIST]]`. Place elements so they do not cover the end card's path pill or disclosure notices (check against the final scene).
* Description and pinned comment carry the store links (`[[LINK_APP_STORE]]`, `[[LINK_PLAY]]`); the video itself shows only the in-app path, no URL and no price.
* Instagram: link in bio (`[[LINK_BIO]]`); ask viewers to save/share, not to "download now".

## 11. Safe-content notes

* No patient data, names or real results anywhere. All numbers on screen are illustrative and labelled so.
* No third-party logo, brand name, stock footage or music. The only logo is the owner's app icon.
* Do not call the voice "natural", "professional" or "human": it is synthetic and nobody has listened to it yet.
* Do not call the content "approved", "verified", "certified" or "clinically validated": expert review is pending.
* No diagnosis, treatment, dosing or "normal range" statement. Reference ranges come from the user's laboratory.
* Do not answer individual medical questions in comments; point to the user's laboratory SOP, the reagent IFU and the clinician.
* No price, discount, product id or availability date in any text (docs/DECISIONS.md D-77/D-78: prices live in the stores).
* Check the platform's own disclosure setting for AI-generated / synthetic voice before posting (NEEDS_OWNER_CHECK: the rules change; the kit already states the voice is synthetic in the text).
* Audience: not made for kids. Category: Education. Comments: moderate; hide spam and requests for medical advice.
